loop.seam: instance (slot j, cycle c) at t + 24 s is where (j, c - 1) is at t, same color

motion.path: feeder rail (x -80 -> 0, 7 deg) -> helix (4 turns, 163.4 units) -> exit rail (x 0 -> 80, 3 deg)

set.rails: dark #32363C, 3.4 wide, side walls 0.26; feeder from x = -90, exit to x = 90, both at z = -6.4 (behind the pole)

camera.note: straight on; pole top at 10% of the height, dish front at 95%; the feeder rail leaves the frame top left, the exit rail right

static_render: 3840x2160 G-buffer, 49 key + 64 ambient samples, 233 s on 2 cores

encode.keyframes: every 60 frames (2 s), no scene-cut keyframes

playlist: Row Row Row Your Boat (190 eighths/min, rounds of 2 and 4)
We Wish You a Merry Christmas (126, 3/4)
Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy (300 sixteenths/min)
music.voices: melody lead bell 0.32, bass 0.19, chord tones 0.072 each, octave sparkles 0.05 (bells.py kinds lead/bass/inner/spark)
music.passes: soft (block chords), flow (broken-chord arpeggio), sparkle (octave sparkles); a final tonic chord with a sparkle run
music.loudness: -16 LUFS per song, -1 dBFS limiter, AAC 192k 48 kHz
